name: tone-fixer
description: Chrome extension to rewrite text in any tone using AI.

scripts.build: terser src/popup/app.js -o dist/popup.js && terser src/options/app.js -o dist/options.js && terser src/shared/providers.js -o dist/providers.js && terser src/popup/style.css -o dist/popup.css && cp src/popup/index.html dist/ && cp src/options/index.html dist/ && cp manifest.json dist/ && cp -r icons dist/ && cp -r src/guide dist/guide
